function.arguments: {"observation": "`arm` and `severity` are strongly associated: treatment arm has a much higher proportion of severe cases (15.6%) compared to control (3.1%), while control has more mild cases (44.6%) than treatment (7.7%). This means the treatment arm is systematically sicker at baseline.", "implication": "Although the question only asks for the response fraction within the treatment arm — a descriptive statistic — the presence of this imbalance means that any comparison of response rates across arms would be confounded. However, since this question is NOT asking for a comparison between arms, and only wants the fraction of responders in the treatment arm alone, the confounding by severity does NOT invalidate the computation. We are not estimating a causal effect; we are computing a simple descriptive fraction. Therefore, we can proceed with the raw fraction within the treatment arm without adjustment."}
function.name: note_finding
